title: Relevant sampling of non-decaying signals in Orlicz and mixed-norm Orlicz spaces defined on a locally compact group
summary: We study the sampling problem for non-decaying signals defined on a locally compact group. The signals are modeled as elements of suitable subspaces of weighted Orlicz and weighted mixed-norm Orlicz spaces, thereby allowing controlled growth at infinity. Our principal focus is on image spaces of idempotent integral operators. Under suitable oscillation estimates on the associated integral kernels, we establish deterministic sampling theorems that guarantee stable reconstruction from pointwise samples.
